relations: Celia（叙述者）；Harriot；Jonathan（前章）；Terry Calahan（日记中的导师）；Edward Carver（1883 死者）

facts.fact: 回程烧痛；脚已响进骨、绷带上红热；彼此只剩毒液
facts.anchor: All we had for each other was venom.
facts.verbatim: All we had for each other was venom.

facts.fact: Harriot 帮她洗脚（动作轻快带怨）；额上有撞车的痕；「你能？」的眼神
她意识到对 Harriot 了解极少（匹兹堡/父亲医生/Tulane/无前景/拟声天赋）却困在一起
facts.anchor: I didn’t know her, and yet I was trapped with her
facts.verbatim: I didn’t know her, and yet I was trapped with her

facts.fact: 「为什么没人知道你在？」她答「我父母知道、Greg 知道、我朋友 Ruth 也知道」——Celia 看出明摆着撒谎
facts.anchor: Because she was lying. Obviously lying.
facts.verbatim: Because she was lying. Obviously lying.

facts.fact: 她翻图书馆（Harriot 散页/伞/衣）；查出沙发后一本黑皮小日记（比祈祷书大不了多少）
日记开头 1/18/83：「若我能救下她的什么，那个 Self……我要把自己钉在此处，一只玻璃罩下的蝶」
2/5/83：Terry 让她在门外等；从不叫她以外的人煮咖啡；推荐信十一月到期；「你有一把刺耳的嗓子」
facts.anchor: That letter of recommendation was due IN NOVEMBER
facts.verbatim: That letter of recommendation was due IN NOVEMBER

facts.fact: 3/18/83：女研究生靠秘书劳动付「存在」的特权；招待会上 Michael Peters 把空杯递给她像她端托盘
4/1/83：化学实验室旧瓶柜（未锁）；深蓝瓶 prussic acid、绿瓶 arsenicum——「Edward Carver 偏爱杏仁」
facts.anchor: Edward Carver, Beatrice Donahue’s husband, was said to prefer almonds
facts.verbatim: Edward Carver, Beatrice Donahue’s husband, was said to prefer almonds

facts.anchor: How many more cups of coffee, Terry?
facts.verbatim: How many more cups of coffee, Terry?

facts.fact: Harriot 白脸在楼梯：「那是私人的」；Celia 只登记警报；「Terry。Terence Calahan——你做了什么？」
她抢回日记「你是小偷」；扬臂要打又停住；「别再问我，Cece。我要走了」
facts.anchor: “Don’t ask me any more, Cece,” she said. “I’m leaving.”
facts.verbatim: “Don’t ask me any more, Cece,” she said. “I’m leaving.”

facts.fact: 她收拾：把草稿塞进包；Celia 抱膝、抓脸；她举起小手枪（你的、来自办公室保险柜）指她；开门走了
她追出、膝垮跌下门廊；「你——bitch！」；Harriot 发在阳光下闪光、带着整个项目跑远
